scope: Compare both possible short-sheet inventories of every distinct 0.2 mm large-plate native layout in the archived census against all 418 remaining whole-job allocation candidates. Compute the smallest number of inter-sheet transfers per layout.
construction: Use every single-transfer receiver corresponding to the independently validated short-sheet layout with seven brackets, four inserts and one cog. Pair its original full-sheet placements with the retained 12 short-sheet placements. Renumber identical copies only. Check the original 66-part request and the explicit 65-part diagnostic request, then independently check every original outer contour against material bounds and neighbours.
completion_attempt: Locate the largest free circle in each qualifying full sheet. Try the remaining true-size cog there first. If required, grow it from a source-valid smaller placement by translating surrounding parts together under original stock bounds. Use the original 66-part request and current CLI to validate any true-size proposal. A partial layout cannot satisfy H5.
